import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static boolean[] used;

    static void dfs(long curr, long K, long P) {
        if (used[(int)curr]) return;
        used[(int)curr] = true;
        dfs(curr * K % P, K, P);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long P = sc.nextLong();
        long K = sc.nextLong();
        sc.close();

        used = new boolean[(int)P];
        long ans = 1L;

        if (K == 1) {
            ans = (ans * P) % MOD;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < P; i++) {
            if (!used[i]) {
                dfs(i, K, P);
                ans = (ans * P) % MOD;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
